appTagline: Apollo TV 4.0 is a ground-up rebuild: a cinematic new interface, voice search, near-instant reopening and steadier playback on every screen you own.
releaseNotes:
A cinematic new look — A darker, cleaner interface with smoother focus and transitions on every screen.
Voice search — Press the mic and say what you want to watch. Works on Fire TV, Android TV and phones.
Opens in a flash — Home loads instantly from your device, then refreshes quietly in the background.
Tougher security — Credentials are stored more safely, usernames are never logged, and builds are signed and minified.

platforms.instructions:
Allow apps from unknown sources. On Fire TV open **Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options**; on Android TV open **Settings → Apps → Security & restrictions**.
Install **Downloader** — from the Amazon Appstore on Fire TV or Google Play on Android TV.
Open Downloader, type the code shown here and select **Go**.
When the download finishes, choose **Install**, then open Apollo Group TV and sign in with your account. Future updates arrive inside the app.

platforms.name: Android Phone & Tablet
platforms.method: Direct APK for phones and tablets
platforms.instructions:
Tap **Download APK** — your browser saves the file to Downloads.
Open it from the download notification or your **Downloads** folder.
If Android asks, allow **Install unknown apps** for your browser. You only do this once.
Tap **Install**, then open **Apollo Group TV** from your app drawer and sign in.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.instructions:
Click **Download DMG** to get the installer.
Open the DMG and drag **Apollo Group TV** into your **Applications** folder.
Open **Terminal**, paste the command shown here and press Return. This is needed once because the app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID.
Launch Apollo Group TV from Launchpad and sign in. Updates download and install inside the app from then on.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.instructions:
Click **Download installer** to save the .exe setup file.
Open the file. Because the installer isn't code-signed, Windows SmartScreen may show a blue warning — choose **More info → Run anyway**.
Follow the setup wizard. The default install folder is fine for most people.
Open **Apollo Group TV** from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut and sign in. Updates install inside the app from then on.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.method: UHF Player from the App Store
platforms.downloadLabel: Get UHF on the App Store
platforms.instructions:
Tap **Get UHF on the App Store**, or search the App Store for “UHF: Love your IPTV”, and install it.
Open UHF, choose **Add Playlist → Xtream Login (Xtream Codes API)**. Don't pick the M3U option — it won't work here.
Enter the server URL shown here, then the username and password from **My Accounts → Player login**, and save.

platforms.name: Apple TV
platforms.downloadLabel: View UHF on the App Store
platforms.instructions:
On your Apple TV, open the **App Store**, search for “UHF: Love your IPTV” and install it.
Open UHF and choose **Add Playlist → Xtream Login (Xtream Codes API)** — not M3U.
Enter the server URL shown here and your username and password from **My Accounts → Player login**. Save, and your channels and on-demand library load.
